analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services Limited reported a strong financial performance for FY26, driven by owned fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and operational efficiency, with total income growing by 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores. Management highlighted positive industry tailwinds including the Maritime India Vision 2030 and increased demand for offshore support vessels, positioning the company well for sustainable long-term growth. During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis and is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27. For the current financial year, management expects a conservative top-line growth of around 10% assuming all vessels are running in the second half, with EBITDA margins continuing in the 45% to 50% band. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a top-line growth of around 10% from current levels for the current financial year, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to continue in the band of 45% to 50%.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

guidance.claim: Management expects the tax rate for FY27 to be around a maximum of 1.5% to 2%.
guidance.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about opportunities in offshore and maritime sectors driven by initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and support packages for shipbuilding.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the opportunities emerging within the offshore and maritime sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Government policies pushing for increased oil production and enhanced drilling programs ensure strong and continuous demand for vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: So, looking at that, we feel that the demand for all these kind of any oil drilling program or production program, you need vessels. And that is where we come in. So, we hope that the demand will be always there quite strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Total acquisition cost for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV, was about $15 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis for FY26, EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, with the EBITDA margin expanding sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: During H2 FY26, EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns a total of 12 vessels, including four smaller vessels serving as pilot and security boats on long-term charters.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat.

capital_allocation.claim: With comfortable debt-equity ratios and adequate reserves, bankers are comfortable with lending and funding will not be a problem.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side. With adequate reserves and all, I think bankers are comfortable for lending at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Currency exchange rate fluctuations impact the acquisition cost of vessels due to the dollar rate movement.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96. So, that is playing on the cost of the vessel.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets expanding the fleet by adding seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: I think Captain has already told that the vision is to expand and to go forward for seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company stays committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
